notes: PAP reference G55/2034. Whole four-room apartment in Tours, on the second floor of a maintained residential building. The complete advert describes three bedrooms, an open fitted kitchen and living room, balcony, separate dressing area, utility room, pantry, separate bathroom and WC, secure bicycle room and available parking spaces. The seller explicitly states an elevator, double glazing and collective heating plus hot and cold water included in monthly charges of EUR 236. Facade works have been voted and paid. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale, delayed-vacancy or special-sale wording. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 3 October 2026.
